claim_boundary: Anonymous cross-sectional self-report data from 78 fencers, not diagnoses, longitudinal training responses, match outcomes, or causal evidence. Exact birth year, exact age, training-start year, exact duration variables, deposited cluster labels, and cluster distances are excluded from the processed table. The identified weapon field gives 4 foil, 68 epee, and 6 sabre rows; two rows disagree with another weapon-code field, and four duration values are internally inconsistent. Because no reuse license is declared and responses are psychologically sensitive, row data remain local-only and analyses must be grouped at participant level.
